Jurisdiction

Monroe Town Court, located in Orange County, New York, serves within the 2nd and 9th Judicial District Departments. The court has jurisdiction over various legal matters, including:

  • Criminal Law and Penal Violations
  • Family Law Violations
  • Small Claims and Evictions
  • Traffic Violations, including cases from Route 17 and other significant roadways
  • Speeding Cases

This court, also known as Monroe Justice Court or Monroe Municipal Court, oversees a range of civic responsibilities.

Case Records

To search Monroe County NY Court Records:

  1. In Person at the Town Clerk’s Office or County Clerk’s Office.
  2. Online via various official record search websites.

Records can be searched by:

  • Name
  • Case Number
  • Address
  • Phone
  • Email

For cases involving sensitive information like Family Violations or Criminal Cases, records may be restricted and only accessible through the County Court. Submit a record request form with your personal details and pay applicable fees to obtain copies.

For more information on records, contact the Monroe Village Office.

Payment Methods

The Monroe Municipal Court accepts payments in the following ways:

  1. In-Person: Cash, checks, or card payments are accepted. Note that credit card payments incur a 2.99% processing fee.
  2. Mail: Send a certified check or money order to 1465 Orange Turnpike, Monroe, NY 10950, USA. Do not send cash or personal checks by mail.
  3. Online: Use the New York State Online Payment Portal. Enter your ticket or case number, keeping in mind that convenience fees will apply.

For traffic ticket payments, search the NJ Traffic Ticket Lookup if you are redirected to NJ for certain payments.

Court Responsibilities

Monroe Town Court handles:

  • Trials: Both jury and non-jury
  • Alcohol and Beverage Control Laws
  • Environmental Conservation Cases
  • Public Health and Mental Hygiene Law
  • Tax, Transportation, Vehicle, and Traffic Law
  • Agricultural and Market Law
  • Local Law and Ordinance Violations

Traffic ticket holders must enter a Plea of Guilty or Not Guilty by the citation date, or face additional fines, license suspension, or a potential warrant.

Plea Options

For traffic, vehicle, or speeding tickets:

  • Plea of Guilty: Acknowledges guilt, leading to fines or a court date in more serious cases.
  • Plea of Not Guilty: Disputes charges and may require a court appearance.

If you are underage, list a parent or guardian’s contact information. Non-compliance with court schedules may result in penalties.

Application to Reduce Charges

For reduced charges in traffic cases, download and complete a reduction request form with your personal details and ticket information. Submit the form to the Monroe Court NY for review.

Concusion

the Monroe Town Court, located at Monroe Town Hall, serves the Town of Monroe, NY, and is an essential part of the local judicial system, providing access to various legal services including handling cases in the Monroe Municipal Building and managing court records through the Monroe County NY Court Records system. Residents can contact the Monroe Township phone number for inquiries related to court matters or visit the Monroe Village Office for additional assistance. The court also oversees operations within the West Monroe Town Court and the Monroe District Court, with specific services available through the Monroe Municipal Court, including options for paying tickets online. For further inquiries, the Monroe Court NY and Monroe Justice Court provide critical legal support, while the Monroe Township Municipal Court in Middlesex County, NJ, handles cases related to local governance and public safety, including those referred by the Monroe Township Police Department. For more detailed information regarding court operations, hours, and services, including how to look up tickets and access court records, residents can explore NJ Courts Online and connect with the Monroe Municipal Court phone number or visit the Monroe Township Municipal Building located at 1 Municipal Plaza, Monroe Township, NJ 08831. The interconnected nature of these facilities ensures that residents have the resources they need for civil, criminal, and municipal matters, contributing to the overall governance and legal framework within both the Village of Monroe, NY, and the broader Monroe Township NJ area.

FAQ

What are the responsibilities of the town prosecutor?

The Monroe Town Court Prosecutor manages plea cases by mail, reductions in traffic points, traffic infractions, and vehicle tickets.
